summary: Chase vLLM 0.34.0 for cuda/vllm and rocm/vllm (CUDA torch 2.14.0 and ROCm torch 2.13.0 unchanged; LMCache 0.5.6 retained per vLLM's own lmcache >= 0.5.6 pin and kept identical across all four CUDA/ROCm recipes; mooncake bumped to 0.3.14; vllm-omni moved to the aligned v0.34.0rc1 tag commit 709dc427). vLLM 0.34.0 drops the ROCm 7.2 runtime line (vllm#61939), so the rocm 7.2 vLLM matrix rule is retired and the obsolete humming-stub patch is removed. SGLang and CANN subscriptions remain unchanged at their pinned lines.

subscriptions.reason: vLLM 0.34.0 is the highest stable release on the next release line above the published 0.33.0; base vllm/vllm-openai:v0.34.0 pins torch 2.14.0 (requirements/cuda.txt) matching the existing VLLM_TORCH_VERSION pin, so only the engine, base image, and vllm-omni commit change.

packages.name: lmcache
packages.reason: vLLM v0.34.0 requirements/kv_connectors.txt pins lmcache >= 0.5.6, so the pinned 0.5.6 already supports the vLLM 0.34 KV connector and stays identical across cuda/vllm, cuda/sglang, rocm/vllm, and rocm/sglang (no MP wire handshake).

packages.name: vllm-omni
packages.reason: vLLM-Omni v0.34.0rc1 (tag commit 709dc427) is the release aligned with vLLM 0.34.0; vllm-omni is whitelisted for prereleases in pack/prereleases.yaml.

patches.reason: Both hunks (_get_reserved_port_range/get_open_port context) match vllm/utils/network_utils.py at v0.34.0; verified with git apply --check against the tag file.
The sys.modules snapshot loop context is unchanged in vllm_omni/patch.py at the 709dc427 commit; verified with git apply --check.

subscriptions.reason: Recipe already pins SGLang 0.5.23, the latest stable upstream release; no newer stable line exists to chase.

packages.name: lmcache
packages.reason: Pinned LMCache line identical across CUDA/ROCm vLLM and SGLang (no MP wire handshake); the vLLM 0.34 chase does not require an LMCache bump.

subscriptions.reason: vLLM 0.34.0 publishes the ROCm 10.0 (TheRock) line only: vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:v0.34.0, mirrored as v0.34.0-rocm100 (vllm#61939 dropped the rocm72 stack, wheels, and image tags), so the ROCm 7.2 vLLM matrix rule is retired with a re-add comment and the recipe defaults move to ROCm 10.0.0. The v0.34.0 ROCm stack pins torch 2.13.0+rocm10.0.0, matching the existing VLLM_TORCH_VERSION pin.

packages.name: lmcache
packages.reason: vLLM v0.34.0 requirements/kv_connectors.txt pins lmcache >= 0.5.6 and the upstream ROCm image builds LMCache from a pinned source ref, so the pinned 0.5.6 (built from source here) supports the vLLM 0.34 KV connector and stays identical to the CUDA and SGLang pins.

packages.name: mooncake
packages.reason: vLLM 0.34.0 bumps its mooncake-transfer-engine dependency to >= 0.3.14 (vllm#65576) for the new KV connector; Mooncake v0.3.14 ships mooncake_transfer_engine_rocm-0.3.14 manylinux x86_64 wheels (cp310-cp314), matching this linux/amd64-only subscription and the TheRock 10.0 native libraries (libamdhip64.so.7, libhsa-runtime64.so.1).

packages.name: vllm-omni
packages.reason: vLLM-Omni v0.34.0rc1 (tag commit 709dc427) is the release aligned with vLLM 0.34.0; vllm-omni is whitelisted for prereleases in pack/prereleases.yaml.

patches.reason: Both hunks match vllm/utils/network_utils.py at v0.34.0; verified with git apply --check against the tag file.
The sys.modules snapshot loop context is unchanged in vllm_omni/patch.py at the 709dc427 commit; verified with git apply --check.

Does not apply at the new vllm-omni commit (git apply --check fails): v0.34.0rc1 removed the module-level _register_humming_stubs() call and now installs the stubs transiently inside _get_quantization_config() with a finally-block sys.modules cleanup, which addresses the patch's original spec-less-stub shadowing rationale. File deleted; no Dockerfile reference needed updating (the vllm_omni patch loop now applies only the 001 patch).
